title: Echoing Sea Cave
description: A dark cave mouth opens in the cliff face, half-submerged at high tide. Strange echoes ripple outward -- dripping water, distant clicks, and something that might be breathing. The air smells of brine and old stone. Phosphorescent lichen traces the walls in pale green lines.

choices.label: Explore the depths
choices.description: The echoes suggest a large chamber deeper inside.

outcomes.text: The cave opens into a vast grotto. Tidal pearls cluster on the ceiling like stars, and old crates from some forgotten cache lie stacked against the far wall.
You find a side passage lined with salt crystal deposits. Not the grand discovery you hoped for, but valuable nonetheless.
The cave narrows and the echoes grow hostile. Something large stirs in the darkness, its shell scraping against stone. You barely make it back to the entrance.

choices.label: Swim through the flooded tunnel
choices.description: A submerged passage leads somewhere. The water is clear enough to see the far side.

outcomes.text: You surface in a hidden air pocket filled with driftwood and kelp. The previous tide deposited a treasure trove of materials.
The tunnel is longer than it looked. You make it through gasping, and find a small cache of shells on the other side.
An electric eel nests in the tunnel. The shock paralyzes your muscles and you barely drag yourself back to air, coughing and numb.

choices.label: Call into the cave
choices.description: Test the echoes. Maybe something calls back.

outcomes.text: Your voice bounces deep into the cave and dislodges loose crystals from the ceiling. They rain down harmlessly, glittering with salt.
Something calls back -- a low, resonant hum that vibrates through your bones. It feels ancient and wise. The party feels strangely refreshed.
The echoes amplify into a deafening shriek. Everyone clutches their ears as the sound reverberates through the cave mouth.
